task_definition.instruction_en: In a fixed robotic workspace, generate a rigid, physically consistent embodied robotic arm. The arm maintains high stability with no deformation and enters the frame to Hold the scanner with blue scanning area with the left arm and the smooth glossy tea-box with the right arm, then scan the smooth glossy tea-box using the scanner with blue scanning area.
task_definition.instruction_zh: 在固定的机器人工作空间中，生成刚性的、物理一致的具体机器人手臂。手臂保持高稳定性，不变形，进入框架，左臂握住蓝色扫描区域的扫描仪，右臂握住光滑的光面茶盒，然后使用蓝色扫描区域的扫描仪扫描光滑的光面茶盒。
